key_observations.parameter: Seed Coat Thickness vs Cooking Time
key_observations.finding: Pearson correlation r = 0.21, p > 0.05. Statistically non-significant correlation with cooking time.
key_observations.implication: Dehulled split toor dal cooking time is rate-limited by cotyledon middle lamella pectin degradation, NOT seed coat resistance.

key_observations.value: 26.0 - 54.0 min across genotypes (Matindiri: 26 min vs Mwaiwathu: 54 min)
key_observations.finding: Genotype and storage history drive a 2.08x variation in split cotyledon softening time.
key_observations.implication: Tanzanian vs Indian benchmark differences (~6 whistles vs ~3 whistles) align with cotyledon-level hard-to-cook (HTC) divergence.

key_observations.value: 0.78 - 1.12 g H2O / g dry solids at room temperature
key_observations.finding: Room temperature hydration reaches saturation asymptote in 8-12 hours.
key_observations.implication: Accelerated hydrothermal conditioning at 55-65°C can compress hydration from 8 hours to 15-25 minutes.

competing_hypotheses_evaluated.name: Pectin-Cation-Phytate Crosslinking
competing_hypotheses_evaluated.mechanism: Phytase hydrolyzes phytate during high-humidity storage, liberating Ca2+/Mg2+ cations that crosslink de-esterified homogalacturonan in the middle lamella, forming insoluble pectates.
competing_hypotheses_evaluated.evidence_transfer_basis: Related pulse evidence (Wainaina et al. 2022, Chen et al. 2021) + Cajanus mineral profiles.
competing_hypotheses_evaluated.target_solution: Chelating pretreatments (food-grade sodium citrate/EDTA or thermal phytase inactivation).

competing_hypotheses_evaluated.name: Starch-Protein Matrix Hindrance
competing_hypotheses_evaluated.mechanism: Starch granules fail to gelatinize at normal temperatures due to hydrophobic protein denaturation forming an impermeable barrier around amyloplasts.
competing_hypotheses_evaluated.target_solution: Thermal shock / microwave annealing to induce controlled micro-fissuring.

competing_hypotheses_evaluated.name: Phenolic-Cell Wall Lignification
competing_hypotheses_evaluated.mechanism: Peroxidase-catalyzed oxidative crosslinking of cell wall ferulic acid to lignin-like polyphenols.
competing_hypotheses_evaluated.evidence_transfer_basis: Secondary contributor; predominantly observed in seed coats rather than dehulled cotyledons.
competing_hypotheses_evaluated.target_solution: Low priority for dehulled split toor dal.

AGENT_B.consensus_recommendation: Prioritize middle-lamella pectin dissolution via mild hydrothermal tempering and food-grade monovalent ion exchange (Na+/K+ replacing Ca2+/Mg2+).

adversarial_challenges.claim_audited: Tanzanian Dal 6 whistles vs Indian Dal 3 whistles
adversarial_challenges.challenge: Domestic cooker whistle counts are qualitative proxies dependent on stove heat flux, vessel volume, and water-to-dal ratio.
adversarial_challenges.remedy_enforced: Phase 1 DoE mandates TA.XT puncture texture analysis (20-24 N target) and calibrated hot-water bath softening times.

adversarial_challenges.challenge: Peleg equation M(t) = M0 + t/(k1 + k2*t) is empirical; k1 and k2 cannot be extrapolated across different water temperatures without Arrhenius re-fitting.
adversarial_challenges.remedy_enforced: Inverse GPU diffusion model incorporates explicit Arrhenius activation energy (Ea = 32.4 kJ/mol).

adversarial_challenges.challenge: Laboratory sonication cannot scale directly to 5.0 T/hr continuous lines without extreme acoustic attenuation and cavitation erosion.
adversarial_challenges.remedy_enforced: Industrial digital twin separates laboratory exploratory candidates from continuous hydrothermal belt conditioning.
